error: RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded

error: Error: EPERM: operation not permitted, unlink 'C:\Users\dev\project\node_modules\.package-lock.json'
context: Windows 10/11 running npm install. File is locked by Windows Defender real-time scanning or an editor with file watchers. The trap is suggesting sudo or chmod which are Unix-only solutions.

error: TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'useRef')
context: React 18 app where a library bundles its own copy of React, causing two React instances. Hooks fail because they reference a different React instance than the one rendering the component tree.

error: Warning: Each child in a list should have a unique 'key' prop.

error: Error: Hydration failed because the initial UI does not match what was rendered on the server.

error: Module not found: Can't resolve 'fs'

error: error TS2590: Expression produces a union type that is too complex to represent.
